description: Create or replace an edge function (Deno, TypeScript). Pass `source` for a single file, or `files` (path -> source) with an `entrypoint`. It is served at <project URL>/functions/v1/<name>. Scope: functions:write.

organization_id.description: Organization id. Optional: defaults to the token's organization, or the only one you belong to.

project_id.description: Project id. Optional: defaults to the project created or used last in this session, or the only one.

verify_jwt.description: Require a valid JWT to call it (default true)

name: functions.deploy
title: Deploy an edge function
